subject.title: macOS active-computer presence lacks dedicated consent

question: Should Accessibility permission remain sufficient for active-computer activity reporting, or must macOS nodes require a separate explicit local consent control that defaults off and clears retained presence on disable?
rationale: This is a product privacy and permission-boundary decision: the correct default and upgrade behavior determine whether existing multi-Mac notification routing continues automatically or requires renewed local consent.

options.title: Require dedicated consent
options.body: Add a separately described local setting, default it off, gate macOS activity reporting, and clear retained presence immediately when it is disabled.

options.title: Treat Accessibility as consent
options.body: Keep current reporting behavior and document that Accessibility authorizes both UI control and active-computer activity telemetry.

recommendation.title: Require dedicated consent
recommendation.body: Add a separately described local setting, default it off, gate macOS activity reporting, and clear retained presence immediately when it is disabled.
